The '''owner''' of the [[Surronian (species)|Surronian]] [[Surronian L19 heavy freighter/Legends|L19 Heavy Freighter]] ''[[Bosphon Forever]]'' was [[Death|killed]] by the [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] [[smuggler]] [[Bora Boru]] after he attempted to reclaim his [[starship]] from the hunter, who had claimed ownership of it using a [[glyph]] pendant.<ref name="SotOR" />
